updateTo.notes: Windows and Linux keep themselves up to date. The Windows download and the Linux tar.gz now check for new versions, verify each one before installing it, and ask before restarting, waiting until you are off a call. An update is accepted only if it matches a release manifest signed with a key built into KithMoot, so even someone who took over the download server could not slip in a different app. Install 0.1.48 by hand once; after that it is automatic.
